A day for each feast

Feast of the Ass

A Rustic Feast for the Humble Ass

Join us for a warm and practical one-day celebration of the Feast of the Ass, bringing the spirit of medieval devotion and carnival humor into your home. This agenda guides you through preparing a rustic feast and honoring the humble donkey's journey.

  1. Morning

    A Humble Beginning

    Start your day by setting a simple, rustic atmosphere in your home. Perhaps light a candle or arrange a few natural elements to honor the humble donkey and the spirit of the festival.

  2. Mid-Morning

    Baking the Heart of the Feast

    Begin baking your Country Bread, allowing its comforting aroma to fill your home. This staple will be the wholesome foundation of your rustic meal.

    Recipes: Rustic Country Bread

  3. Lunchtime

    Simmering Soups & Spices

    Prepare the hearty Dried Pea Soup, a warming dish perfect for a simple midday meal. Also, begin infusing your Spiced Wine Hypocras so its flavors can deepen.

    Recipes: Hearty Dried Pea Soup · Spiced Wine Hypocras

  4. Afternoon

    Embrace the Bray

    In the spirit of the historical procession, take a moment for playful reflection. Share stories of journeys or even a lighthearted 'hee-haw' to honor the donkey's role in biblical tales.

  5. Late Afternoon

    Assembling the Rustic Spread

    Finish preparing the Honey Galette and Walnut Tart, and arrange the creamy Goat Cheese. Your rustic feast, 'le repas rustique,' is almost ready to be enjoyed.

    Recipes: Honey Galette · Medieval Walnut Tart for the Feast of the Ass · Festive Baked Goat Cheese with Herbs and Honey

  6. Evening

    The Humble Feast

    Gather to share your 'repas rustique,' savoring the simple, wholesome flavors. Enjoy the Country Bread, Dried Pea Soup, Honey Galette, Walnut Tart, Goat Cheese, and Spiced Wine Hypocras, remembering the blend of devotion and carnival humor.

    Recipes: Rustic Country Bread · Hearty Dried Pea Soup · Honey Galette · Medieval Walnut Tart for the Feast of the Ass · Festive Baked Goat Cheese with Herbs and Honey · Spiced Wine Hypocras

  7. After Dinner

    A Toast to the Ane

    Conclude your feast with a final cup of Spiced Wine Hypocras, raising a toast to the humble ass and the joyous spirit of this unique festival.

    Recipes: Spiced Wine Hypocras

May your Feast of the Ass be filled with warmth, good food, and a touch of playful reverence.
